minstret

Source:

Description

Lower 32 bits of the retired-instruction counter. Increments when i_instret_inc pulses (approximated in the RTL as 'a uop is issued this cycle', not a true retire pulse — see rtl/pipeline/issue.sv). SW may also write it (same race caveat as mcycle).
